newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE PROMPT BUNKERS FETCH HIGH PREMIUMS.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE PROMPT BUNKERS FETCH HIGH PREMIUMS.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were steady on Tuesday with the prompt supplies still commanding a hefty premium, traders said.
They said 380-cst sellers were at $104/$105 per tonne and 180-cst was offered at around $107-108.
"There's still a lot of demand for prompt cargoes for delivery over the next few days and the shipowners are willing to pay up to $5.00 more," one major said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated at $168 and $178 per tonne, respectively.
